page_title: ALM 3-3 GRA | Almeria v Granada CF 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF) misses a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but placed the ball only against the right post!
90+8' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!

90+7' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
90+4' Raul Torrent (Granada CF) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+4' Raul Torrent (Granada CF) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' 11 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Shon Weissman (Granada CF) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Boye.
88' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
86' 3 - 3 Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the top right corner.
84' Alberto Lasarte Ruiz has decided to make a change. Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) replaces Arnau Puigmal.
83' Problems for Alberto Lasarte Ruiz as Luis Suarez (Almeria) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ibrahima Kone replaces him.
83' The game is interrupted now, Luis Suarez (Almeria) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' Yellow card. Sergio Akieme (Almeria) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
81' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes sees the trip by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Almeria have a free kick.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
73' It will be a substitution. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonio Puertas walks off.
71' 3 - 2 Fabulous goal. Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a low shot from the edge of the box which goes in off the left post.
68' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) attempts to find Ricard Sanchez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
66' 3 - 1 Goal! Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Luis Maximiano into the bottom left corner.
66' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
65' Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Granada CF are awarded a penalty kick!
65' The referee shows the yellow card to Arnau Puigmal (Almeria).
61' That looked a certain handball by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
57' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Luis Maximiano pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
57' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) brings an opponent down and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes interrupts the game. A penalty is given to Granada CF!
55' The corner from Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is intercepted by the defence.
54' Granada CF take a short corner kick.
50' Substitution. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) in, Ignasi Miquel out.
49' That's the end of the game for Largie Ramazani, who is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Almeria).
46' Half-time substitution. Alberto Lasarte Ruiz decided to make a change. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is replaced by Sergio Arribas.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paco Lopez gives a chance to Gonzalo Villar and Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is off.
46' Paco Lopez has made a change at the break. Alvaro Fernandez has come on in place of Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+11' The match has reached half-time.
45+10' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+10' Luis Suarez (Almeria) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. Almeria will have an opportunity.
45+9' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+8' A lofted pass picks out Jose Callejon (Granada CF) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Granada CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+5' 5:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
45+1' 3 - 0 Luis Suarez (Almeria) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
45' We will have 9 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Largie Ramazani plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Luis Suarez (Almeria). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.

41' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Largie Ramazani slips the ball through to Luis Suarez (Almeria), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
39' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Bryan Zaragoza, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the right post.
35' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is penalised for a foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had a clear view and blows his whistle. Granada CF will take a free kick.
34' Substitution. Edgar Gonzalez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria).
32' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
28' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him.
26' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
23' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

20' Andre Ferreira pulls off a great save to deny Leo Baptistao (Almeria) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
20' Wonderful pass from Leo Baptistao (Almeria) for Luis Suarez, but they can't profit from it as Andre Ferreira comes off his line to collect.
18' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

18' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Granada CF are awarded a corner kick.
15' A cross from Sergio Akieme (Almeria) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
14' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Good movement by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.

11' Big chance! A simple pass from Bryan Zaragoza left Lucas Boye (Granada CF) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
10' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jose Callejon (Granada CF). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

9' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kaiky (Almeria). Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Granada CF are awarded the free kick.
5' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF). The ball is out of play. Granada CF will have a throw-in.
3' Neat passing move from Granada CF in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Almeria will kick-off.
